# puppeteer

Browsers Puppeteer downloaded for testing. They download again on the next install.

**Name:** Puppeteer browsers · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://pptr.dev/guides/configuration>

**Detected when** one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `$PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR` → default `~/.cache/puppeteer`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}/*` (one item per entry) | Puppeteer {parent} {name} | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `quarantine` |
